scope: Offline healthy-volunteer daily activities. Participant-specific reference posture, retrospectively filtered wrist-angle targets. Observations from the four final test volunteers were not evaluated.
modification: Selected historical raw forearm EMG, derived sixteen RMS bins per channel, fitted task-and-time and paired task/time-plus-EMG predictors, and computed participant-balanced aggregate differences.
primary_and_public_models: Primary scientific comparison uses private full fitted heads. The separate support-limited pair includes only features supported by at least seven TRAIN people and is included for public inference.
